subject: Referral for Shared Patient
body: Hi Dr. Sullivan, I'm referring a patient to your clinic for a cardiology follow-up. My office will send the relevant chart notes through our secure referral system by end of day. Let me know if you need anything else in the meantime. Best, Dr. Chen

subject: Update on Our Shared Patient's Care Plan
body: Wanted to give you a quick update on our shared patient's care plan following their visit last week. Things are progressing well and no changes are needed at this time. I'll send a full summary through secure messaging by Friday.

subject: Discharge Summary Sent to Portal
body: The discharge summary for the patient we discussed has been uploaded to the secure provider portal. Take a look when you have a chance, and let me know if you have any questions about the plan going forward.

subject: Consult Scheduled for Next Tuesday
body: This confirms the consult for our shared patient has been scheduled for next Tuesday at 10 AM. Chart notes will be sent through the secure system ahead of the appointment as usual. Thanks for coordinating on this.

subject: Following Up on Last Week's Referral
body: Just following up on the referral sent last week, wanted to check if you needed any additional information before the patient's first visit. Happy to send over lab results if helpful.

subject: Care Coordination Note
body: Sharing a brief care coordination note after our patient's recent hospital stay. Everything is stable and the discharge plan is on track. Full documentation will follow through the usual secure channel.

subject: Thanks for the Quick Turnaround
body: Thanks for getting back to us so quickly on the referral, the patient really appreciated being seen this week. We'll continue coordinating through the shared portal going forward.

subject: Referral Accepted - Scheduling Details to Follow
body: This confirms we've accepted the referral for your patient and our scheduling team will reach out directly to arrange their first appointment. No action needed from your office at this time.

subject: Quick Note on the Transfer of Care
body: Wanted to send a quick note confirming the transfer of care went smoothly on our end. The patient's records were received through the secure portal and everything looks complete.

subject: Checking In on Our Mutual Patient
body: Hi, just checking in on how our mutual patient is doing since the referral last month. No urgency, just wanted to stay in the loop on their progress whenever you have a moment.

subject: Care Coordination Team Update
body: This is a routine update from our Care Coordination team. Your shared patient's treatment plan has been finalized and documentation is available through the secure provider system whenever convenient to review.

subject: Referral Documentation Sent
body: The referral documentation for the patient we discussed on our call has been sent through the secure system. Please let us know if anything is missing or unclear.

subject: Great Working With Your Team
body: Just wanted to say it's been great working with your team on our shared patients this quarter, the coordination has made a real difference for continuity of care. Looking forward to continuing.

subject: Follow-Up Appointment Confirmed
body: This confirms the follow-up appointment for the patient we co-manage has been scheduled. I'll send updated notes through the secure portal before the visit as usual.

subject: Discharge Planning Note
body: Sharing a brief discharge planning note for the patient transitioning back to your care. Everything looks routine, full records are available in the portal whenever you have time to review.

subject: Thanks for the Referral
body: Thanks for sending the referral our way, we were able to get the patient scheduled for next week. We'll keep your office updated on progress through the usual channels.

subject: Consult Notes Now Available
body: The consult notes from yesterday's visit are now available in the shared provider portal. Nothing urgent to flag, just wanted to let you know they're posted whenever convenient.

subject: Regarding the Patient We Discussed at Grand Rounds
body: Following up on the patient we briefly discussed at grand rounds, I've sent a referral through the secure system with the relevant history attached there rather than by email.

subject: Transitions of Care - Routine Update
body: This is a routine update from Transitions of Care confirming the patient's handoff to your practice was completed successfully. No further action is needed on your end at this time.

subject: Nice Catching Up at the Conference
body: It was great catching up at the conference last week. As mentioned, I'll be sending a referral your way for a patient who could benefit from your practice's expertise, more details to follow through the portal.

subject: Referral Packet Uploaded
body: The referral packet for our shared patient has been uploaded to the secure system as usual. Let me know if you run into any access issues on your end.

subject: Second Opinion Referral - Routine
body: Referring a patient who requested a second opinion, nothing unusual about the case. Chart history is available through the secure portal whenever you're ready to review.

subject: Quick Update Before Your Visit With Our Patient
body: Quick update before your visit with our shared patient tomorrow, everything has been stable since their last appointment and no new concerns have come up.

subject: Care Plan Finalized
body: The care plan for our shared patient has been finalized after this week's review. I'll make sure the updated documentation is in the portal before your next visit with them.

subject: Appreciate the Detailed Notes
body: Appreciate the detailed notes you sent over on the referral, it made scheduling and prep much easier on our end. Looking forward to seeing the patient next week.

subject: Handoff Complete
body: This confirms the patient handoff between our practices is now complete. All records were transferred through the secure system and everything appears to be in order.

subject: Coordinating Care for Our Patient
body: Reaching out to coordinate care for a patient we both see. I'll send over my most recent notes through the portal so we're aligned on next steps before their upcoming visit.

subject: Referral Received, Thank You
body: Just confirming the referral was received on our end, thank you for sending it along so promptly. We'll be in touch once the patient is scheduled.

subject: Routine Follow-Up After Referral
body: This is a routine follow-up after last month's referral, just wanted to check that everything went smoothly on your end and see if there's anything further needed from our office.

subject: Sharing Updated Chart Ahead of Visit
body: Sharing an updated chart ahead of the patient's visit with your office next week, nothing major has changed since the last note but wanted to keep you current.

subject: Thanks for Taking This Referral
body: Thanks for being willing to take this referral on short notice, the patient really needed a specialist opinion and your office came through. Records are in the portal whenever convenient.

subject: Case Coordination Note From Insurance
body: This is a routine case coordination note confirming the member's referral to your practice has been processed. No action is required from your office at this time.

subject: Following Up After Discharge
body: Following up after the patient's discharge last week, everything has been going well per their last check-in. Full discharge summary is available in the portal as always.

subject: Great to Partner With Your Practice
body: Great to be partnering with your practice on this patient's care, the coordination so far has been smooth. I'll keep sending updates through the secure system as things progress.

subject: Referral Update - No Changes Needed
body: Just a short update on the referral from earlier this month, no changes are needed at this time and the patient's next visit is already scheduled with your office.

subject: Chart Access Granted
body: This confirms chart access has been granted for the referred patient through our shared provider system. You should be able to view the full history whenever needed.

subject: Thanks for the Quick Response on the Consult
body: Thanks for getting back to us so quickly on the consult request, really helped move things along for the patient. We'll follow up with any additional notes through the portal.

subject: Patient Doing Well Post-Referral
body: Wanted to let you know the patient you referred is doing well and follow-up care is on track. No concerns to flag at this point, will keep you posted as needed.

subject: Referral Note From Front Desk
body: Hi, this is the front desk confirming we received the referral note for your patient and have them scheduled for next Wednesday. Let us know if the timing needs to change.

subject: Coordination Call Recap
body: Recapping our coordination call from earlier, we agreed to proceed with the referral as discussed and I'll send the relevant chart excerpt through the secure system shortly.

subject: Consult Request Acknowledged
body: Acknowledging receipt of the consult request sent this morning, we'll have a response for you by the end of the week once our specialist has reviewed the case.

subject: Shared Patient Update From Pharmacy
body: This is a routine update from the pharmacy regarding a shared patient's medication reconciliation following their recent referral. Everything has been processed without issue.

subject: Referral Closing the Loop
body: Just closing the loop on the referral from a few weeks back, the patient's follow-up went well and no further coordination is needed at this time. Thanks for your help on this one.

subject: Appreciate the Smooth Handoff
body: Really appreciated how smooth the handoff was for our shared patient, made the transition much easier for everyone involved. Looking forward to more collaboration ahead.

subject: Insurance Case Manager Check-In
body: This is a routine check-in from the case manager assigned to a member recently referred to your practice. No action needed, just confirming everything is on track.

subject: Notes From Today's Shared Visit
body: Sharing a brief note from today's visit with our shared patient, everything went as expected and I'll have a fuller summary in the portal by tomorrow.

subject: Referral Wrap-Up
body: Wrapping up the referral from last month, the patient's case has been resolved successfully and no further follow-up is required from either practice at this point.
